mcp.title: MCP tools
mcp.description: Every tool of the Runbase MCP server, generated from its definitions.
mcp.intro: The MCP server exposes {count} tools at `/api/mcp`. Every tool except `workspaces.list` and `workspaces.use` accepts an optional `workspace` parameter (id or name); without it, the active workspace is used.
mcp.groupDescription: The {group}.* tools of the Runbase MCP server, generated from their definitions.

nodes.title: Workflow nodes
nodes.description: Every workflow node, generated from the block catalog and the connectors.
nodes.intro: Built-in nodes run in the workflow engine. Connector nodes (`node.<id>`) come from `connectors/` and run in the functions sandbox. Workspace functions are also available as `fn.<name>` nodes.

api.title: REST API
api.description: Every endpoint of the /api/v1 REST API, generated from the OpenAPI spec.
api.spec: The machine-readable spec is served at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`.

selfHosting.description: Run Runbase on your own server with Docker, using prebuilt images.
